Study.body:
## What the records say

The invented register names [[person:05]] and her siblings in one household entry. The Willowmere return lists [[person:05|Elara]] with [[person:13]] after 1802.

- **Documented:** the register entry for the four children of [[person:01]].
- *Probable:* the link for person 10, because a second adult shares the given name.

> Every source in this study is invented for demonstration.

## Still to check

Whether [[question:household]] can be answered from the household returns alone.
Study.conclusion: The Lanternford children are documented as Ada Alder's; the Willowmere household is a probable continuation of Elara Cairn's line, pending [[finding:willowmere-household]].
Study.rationale: Several children share given names across the two places. This study sets out which records tie each child to Ada Alder and which links remain uncertain.
Study.summary: How the invented Lanternford register and Willowmere returns connect Ada Alder's children to the Willowmere branch.
Study.title: Two households, one family: Lanternford and Willowmere
